about: Daily Radar indices (radar/indices.py, 2.67). Bullets: each index the radar forecasts (next session's big-move chance). The main entry (Bank Nifty) is the original radar and keeps its own folders, Telegram message and schedule unchanged; every other 'on' index gets its own models (models/indices/<key>) and results (output/indices/<key>), trained and graded the same way, walk-forward by year on days the model never saw. Information only: nothing trades on it. Expiry calendars are dated data (weekday or null, from a date); where an exchange's history is not certain the calendar follows NSE's market-wide monthly expiry and leaves weekly out.

indices.name: Fin Nifty
indices.note: Weekly options Jan 2021 to Nov 2024; before 2021 the market-wide Thursday expiry is used.

indices.name: Nifty Next 50
indices.note: Monthly contracts only; the market-wide NSE expiry day is used.

indices.name: Sensex
indices.note: Weekly options from May 2023 (Friday, Tuesday from Jan 2025, Thursday from Sep 2025); monthly uses the market-wide Thursday expiry.
